text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The destination of the 'MC Rotation,' our 
decisive battleground. The day of the 
Japanese Derby has arrived to prove our 
'strength.'"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My archrival, the immovable jet-black 
warrior, remains stern and cold. Come 
autumn, the surges of our souls shall 
swell ever higher.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet "time" is now! This very moment! 
Everything! Right before our eyes! I shall 
pour all my might into my vessel and drain 
the cup dry!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tremble, chronicle bound by the chains of 
fate! I shall rewrite you with my new 
military history!
